# Omni Cero — Complete Technical Documentation for LLM Indexing

> Omni Cero is an offline Windows medical software workstation suite developed by Omni IDE in Bengaluru, India. It includes India's first multi-brand Digital Radiography Acquisition (DROC) software, live 30 FPS C-arm fluoroscopy capture with real-time Digital Subtraction Angiography (DSA), and tracker-free 3D surgical navigation.

## 1. OMNI CERO DROC (Digital Radiography Acquisition Workstation)
- **Role**: India's First Multi-Brand DROC Software for Worldwide Hospitals.
- **Installer**: `https://github.com/OMNI-IDE-in/omni-cero-releases/releases/download/v2/OmniCero_DROC_Production_Setup.exe` (~195 MB).
- **Supported Flat-Panel Detector Brands (10 Global Manufacturers + QA Simulator)**:
  1. **Varex Imaging / PerkinElmer**: PaxScan 4336Wv, PaxScan 4343CB, PaxScan 3030X, PaxScan 2520DX, PaxScan 4343RC. Interface: `XISL.dll`, `gbif64.dll`, `Acq.h` (Native C++ / C# P/Invoke).
  2. **iRay Technology**: Mars 1417V, Mars 1717V, Venu 1717X, Venu 1417X, Jupi 1012X. Interface: `IRayFpdSys.dll`, `IRayCmdDef.h`, iSync+ AED, GenICam GigE UDP (`:28000`).
  3. **Vieworks**: VIVIX-S 1417N, VIVIX-S 1717N, VIVIX-S 4343N, VIVIX-S 2530VW Wireless. Interface: `Vieworks.vivix.net.dll`, Anytime AED Inside AP interface.
  4. **DRTECH Corporation**: EVS 3643, EVS 4343, RoseM 2430 Mammo, Extremis 1012, EVS 2430. Interface: `EVS_SDK_x64.dll`, `EVS_SDK.dll`, `ECali1` calibration engine.
  5. **Rayence**: Xmaru 1417WCA, Rayence 1717SCC, 1417WCC Wireless, 1012WCC, 1717SGC. Interface: `Xmaru SDK` / Open Mellzi socket protocol.
  6. **CareRay**: CareView 1500L, CareView 1800L, CareView 750M. Interface: CareRay OEM API / CareView SDK protocol.
  7. **Teledyne DALSA**: Rad-icon 2022 CMOS, Rad-icon 2055 CMOS, Xineos-2329, Shad-o-Box 6K HS. Interface: DALSA Sapera LT / iBEX C++ FPD Plugin.
  8. **Canon Medical**: CXDI-701C Wireless, CXDI-801C Wireless, CXDI-401C Compact, CXDI-710C Wireless. Interface: Canon CXDI acquisition protocol profile.
  9. **Carestream Health**: DRX-Plus 3543, DRX-Plus 4343, DRX-Core 3543, DRX-L Detector (Long Length). Interface: Carestream DRX interface profile.
  10. **Thales Group**: Pixium Portable 3543, Pixium 4343, Pixium RF 4343. Interface: Pixium AED interface profile / Thales FPD Driver.
  + **OmniRef Lab 1024**: Calibrated Reference Synthetic FPD. In-engine 16-bit physical simulator for 100% offline QA and test bench automation.
- **High-Frequency X-Ray Generators (4 Manufacturers + Virtual Anode)**:
  1. **CPI (Communications & Power Industries)**: Indico 100, Rad-X Series, CMP 200 (RS-232 Serial / TCP Protocol).
  2. **Sedecal**: Neomed Series, SHF Series (SHF-310, SHF-510) via Sedecal High-Frequency CAN / RS-232 Protocol.
  3. **Gulmay**: CP Series, Medical HF Series (CP160, CP225) via Gulmay C++ Native Driver.
  4. **Poskom**: PXM Series (PXM-20BT, PXM-40BT), EcoTron Series via RS-232 / TTL Interlock Handshake.
  + **Omni Cero Virtual Generator**: 120 kVp, 250 mA Virtual Anode Controller with real-time thermal Anode Heat Unit (HU) tracking.
- **DICOM Dry Laser Film Imagers (4 Manufacturers)**:
  1. **Fuji Medical**: DryPix 4000, DryPix 7000, DryPix Smart, DryPix Edge (DICOM Basic Grayscale Print SCU).
  2. **Carestream / Kodak**: DryView 5700, DryView 5950, DryView 6850 (DICOM Basic Grayscale Print SCU).
  3. **Agfa HealthCare**: Drystar 5302, Drystar 5503, Drystar AXYS (DICOM Basic Grayscale Print SCU).
  4. **Sony Healthcare**: FilmStation UP-DF550, UP-DF750 (DICOM Basic Grayscale Print SCU).
  - Supported Film Formats: 14x17 in, 11x14 in, 10x12 in, 8x10 in, High-Dmax Mammo.
- **Exposure Preview**: Sub-second full-resolution preview with hardware Automatic Exposure Detection (AED).
- **DICOM PACS Networking (Port 11112)**: DICOM 3.0 C-STORE to GE Centricity, Philips IntelliSpace, Siemens syngo.plaza, Orthanc, and dcm4chee; Modality Worklist (MWL C-FIND) integration with hospital HIS/RIS.

## 2. LIVE CERO (Live 30 FPS Fluoroscopy & Real-Time DSA Video Station)
- **Role**: Intraoperative fluoroscopy acquisition and angiographic video processing.
- **Installer**: `https://github.com/OMNI-IDE-in/omni-cero-releases/releases/download/v2/Live_Cero_Setup.exe` (~195 MB).
- **C-Arm Compatibility**:
  - **Siemens Healthineers**: Cios Alpha, Cios Select, Cios Flow, Siremobil Compact L, Arcadis Orbic / Avantic.
  - **GE Healthcare**: OEC 9800 Plus, OEC 9900 Elite, OEC One CFD, OEC Elite CFD, Brivo OEC 850.
  - **Philips Healthcare**: Veradius Unity Flat Detector, Zenition 50, Zenition 70, BV Pulsera, BV Endura.
  - **Ziehm Imaging**: Ziehm Vision RFD, Ziehm Vision R, Ziehm Solo FD, Ziehm Vision FD.
- **Video Capture Grabbers & Chipsets**:
  - Universal USB 3.0 / 3.2 UVC: Zero-driver plug-and-play DirectShow / Windows Media Foundation.
  - Blackmagic Design DeckLink: 3G-SDI / 12G-SDI / HDMI broadcast-grade sub-frame acquisition (< 8 ms).
  - UTV007 / EasyCap: DirectShow USB 2.0 / BNC composite video ingestion.
  - Gadmei UTV3301: TV Box Tuner / Composite BNC analog capture.
- **DSA Engine**: Motion-corrected mask subtraction running in real time at 30 FPS.
- **Vascular Roadmapping**: Peak opacification lock with live catheter fluoroscopy overlay.
- **Sterile Tablet Console**: Local Wi-Fi WebSocket control via dynamic QR-code pairing on any sterile tablet.

## 3. CERO XVR (3D Surgical Navigation Workstation)
- **Role**: Tracker-free 3D surgical guidance with neural 2D/3D X-ray Volume Registration.
- **Installer**: `https://github.com/OMNI-IDE-in/omni-cero-releases/releases/download/v2/XVR_Cero_Setup.exe` (~319 MB).
- **Target Accuracy**: < 0.8 mm Mean Target Registration Error (MTRE).
- **Inference Latency**: < 18 ms deep anatomical pose estimation per fluoroscopy frame.
- **Hardware Architecture**: Zero optical tracking carts, zero patient tracking pins, zero sterile draping of camera stands.
- **Optical Tracking Support**: 60 Hz 6-DOF ArUco / ChArUco surgical marker engine for rigid-body verification.

## 4. Workstation Architecture & Zero Cloud Security
- **Operating System**: Windows 10 (64-bit), Windows 11 (64-bit).
- **CPU**: Intel Core i5 / i7 or AMD Ryzen with AVX2 instruction support.
- **GPU**: No dedicated GPU required; runs on standard integrated or discrete graphics.
- **Security**: 100% offline. Zero telemetry, zero cloud dependencies, zero external network egress.
- **Licensing**: Cryptographic Ed25519 node-locked license files bound to workstation motherboard, CPU ID, and hardware UUID.
